description: Work out UK statutory redundancy pay for redundancies on or after 6 April 2026, using the gov.uk count-back method: for each full year of service (up to 20), 1.5 weeks if worked aged 41+, 1 week aged 22 to 40, and 0.5 weeks under 22. Weekly pay is capped at £751 and the total at £22,530. At least 2 full years of service are needed. Amounts in GBP. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/redundancy-pay-calculator/

years.description: Full years of continuous service (0 to 60, cannot exceed age)
